#!/bin/bash
# Differential test: executable vs node test12.mjs, byte-for-byte stdout.
EXE=/workspace/dataset/test12_executable
JS="node /output/test12.mjs"
pass=0; fail=0

run_case() {
  local exp act
  exp=$("$EXE" "$@" 2>/dev/null)
  act=$($JS "$@" 2>/dev/null)
  if [ "$exp" == "$act" ]; then
    pass=$((pass+1))
  else
    fail=$((fail+1))
